integrity: Original vertex-neighborhood definition checked by a standalone finite enumerator; analytic arguments establish the infinite formulas. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two equal cliques with a partial cross-matching; no arbitrary cross-edge structure or more layers. The scalar K_n-square-K_2 value is already published; the claim concerns the full all-palette enumerator and partial-matching classification. Prior-literature uncertainty persists.
title: The locally identifying coloring polynomial of two cliques joined by a partial matching
